historical_context.title: Eric Blair in colonial Burma
historical_context.description: Eric Blair traveled to Burma in 1922 to join the Imperial Police; the experience shaped later Orwell writing and the Burma biographical drama.

historical_context.title: George Orwell and the Spanish Civil War
historical_context.description: Orwell served in Spain and later wrote Homage to Catalonia; the BBC adaptation is explicitly part of the 2013 Orwell season.

historical_context.title: The Real George Orwell BBC Radio 4 season
historical_context.description: BBC Radio 4 season combined major adaptations, biographical dramas, factual programs and rebroadcast readings about Orwell.
